title: DEFECT-UAT-007 Resume Reader Journey After Completed Scene Analysis

root_cause.pipeline: Formal scene_pipeline marks AnalysisRun.status=succeeded after Scene Analysis only; Reader Journey is a separate follow-on via POST /analysis-runs/{id}/reader-journey (requires succeeded).
root_cause.ux: Chapter shell treated scene-succeeded as full completion; ResultViewSwitcher and generate path were gated/hidden when ReaderJourneyRun was absent, so humans saw Scene results with a dead「分析结果」label and no journey start entry.
root_cause.not_canary_only: Production create/preflight/progress/resume APIs already exist; remediation reuses them from the chapter shell.

correct_state_machine_ui.backend_invariant_preserved: AnalysisRun.status===succeeded still means scene_pipeline complete (certified). No FROZEN_CERTIFIED / FROZEN_CONTRACT changes.

shell_composition.awaiting_reader_journey_start: scene succeeded + no succeeded journey visualization
shell_composition.succeeded: scene succeeded + journey succeeded + visualization present

full_success_requires: Chapter Journey / Phase / Scene Profiles present via journey result

resume_api.provider: Inherited from AnalysisRun via production API (UAT Run #5: aliyun_qwen_plus / qwen3.7-plus; auto_route=false on run). Not hard-coded in desktop business code.
resume_api.budget: Preflight + within_budget gate before create; no ReaderJourneyRun on reservation failure

resume_card.title: Scene分析已完成
resume_card.body: 阅读旅程尚未生成…不会重新执行场景边界和Scene分析

ui.processing: ReaderJourneyProgressCard + poll; Tasks page via run_id link
ui.on_success: auto-open tab=reader-journey when transitioning from reader_journey_processing

tests: ReaderJourneyResumeCard preflight + budget block + idempotent client_request_id + resume path
BookRoutePage switcher + resume card + progress card + banner copy

tasks_center.succeeded_without_journey: Scene分析已完成 + 继续生成阅读旅程 → chapter result tab=reader-journey

human_next_step: Open /books/1?chapter=2&analysisRun=5&view=result → 阅读旅程 → review preflight → 继续生成阅读旅程 (user-initiated only). Restart desktop if UI was already open before this build.
